subject: Security discovery recap & next steps — SOC 2 / pen test / DPA items
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Anna Walsh <anna.walsh@finserv-co.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-07T14:05:00-08:00
Subject: Security discovery recap & next steps — SOC 2 / pen test / DPA items

Anna — thanks again for the 30-minute call earlier. Quick recap from our side and clear next steps so we stay aligned. If I missed anything, happy to update.

High-level pain / goals you shared:
- Need audit-grade event & access logs retained for 7 years for regulatory reporting; current vendor cannot produce tamper-evident exports quickly.
- SOC 2 Type II scope: want evidence that inference logs and admin activity are in-scope, plus separation of customer data between hosted and dedicated deployments.
- Pen test evidence: procurement wants a summary of latest third-party pen test and whether any critical/major findings remain open.
- Data processing agreement (DPA) and security questionnaire turnaround: goal to complete legal review within 4 weeks for an initial pilot.
- Performance: desire predictable 99th percentile latency for inference (we discussed Dedicated capacity as option).

What Redwood will provide (ASAP):
1) SOC 2 Type II 2025 report (redacted) — attached as stub; we can provide SOC2 auditor contact under NDA.
2) High-level pen-test summary — attached stub. If you need full report, procurement/legal will require an NDA; we can coordinate.
3) Data-retention matrix outlining what logs are captured, retention windows, retention-by-region, and how exports are produced.
4) Draft DPA for initial review (attached v1).
5) Proposed dates for a compliance deep-dive: 45-minute session with our security engineer (Karthik) + CS (Marissa) to walk through logs, exports, and demo retention UI.

Suggested next steps / owners:
- Rafael (me): share the attachments and HubSpot deal record; schedule the compliance deep-dive.
- Karthik: prepare a short runbook for how we produce tamper-evident audit exports and our encryption-at-rest/ in-transit controls.
- Marissa: prepare an ingress checklist for the pilot (SAML, IP allowlist, VPC peering options).
- Anna / FinServ procurement: confirm whether procurement requires the full pen test report (with NDA) or summary will suffice for initial review.

Proposed times for the deep-dive (PST): Tuesday 2026-11-10 10:00–10:45, Wednesday 2026-11-11 14:00–14:45, or Thursday 2026-11-12 09:00–09:45. Let me know preferred slot and who from your team will join (security, legal, procurement).

Thanks — Rafael

--
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0191
https://redwood.ai
From: Anna Walsh <anna.walsh@finserv-co.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@finserv-co.com
Date: 2026-11-08T09:23:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Security discovery recap & next steps — SOC 2 / pen test / DPA items

Rafael — thanks for the tidy recap. A few clarifications from our side before the deep-dive: 

1) Pen test: procurement will accept the summary for now but legal will likely request the full report later. We can start with the summary.
2) Logs: we need tamper-evidence (WORM or signed manifests) for admin changes and model inference logs. Can your export include signed hashes and a verifiable chain?
3) Retention: 7 years is the baseline; we may ask for custodial export capability (SFTP or secure transfer) quarterly.
4) DPA: please send editable track-changes DOCX so our legal team can redline.

We can do the deep-dive on Wednesday 2026-11-11 14:00 PST. Attendees from our side: me (Infra), Jordan Li (Security), and procurement (procurement@finserv-co.com).

One ask: can you include a short bulleted mapping of which Redwood logs correspond to our regulatory categories (audit log, access log, inference trace, system events) so Jordan has that for the call?

Appreciate it — Anna

--
Anna Walsh
Director of Infrastructure, FinServ Co.
anna.walsh@finserv-co.com | +1 (415) 555-4321
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Anna Walsh <anna.walsh@finserv-co.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-08T16:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Security discovery recap & next steps — SOC 2 / pen test / DPA items

Great — thanks Anna, confirmed for Wed 2026-11-11 14:00 PST. 

Attached are the items we discussed (attached as stubs in this export):
- SOC2-Type-II-report-2025.pdf (redacted-stub)
- pen_test_summary_2025.pdf (summary-stub)
- data-retention-matrix.xlsx (stub)
- DPA_draft_Redwood_v1.docx (editable)

Karthik — can you prepare the 10–12 slide deep-dive covering:
- Mapping: Redwood log names -> regulatory categories (audit/access/inference/system) with examples of event payloads;
- Export formats we support (signed JSONL, gzipped CSV, signed manifests);
- Tamper-evidence approach (signed manifests + offset hashes + time-stamped receipts);
- Where we store keys / KMS model for customer-run vs Redwood-managed;
- Quick run of how Dedicated pools separate tenant resources and isolation by default.

Marissa — can you pull together the pilot onboarding checklist (SAML metadata, allowed CIDR list, expected traffic profile) and a one-pager for the legal team describing pilot scope?

Anna — for procurement, the HubSpot deal ID is: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/34567; we also created a DocuSign envelope for the DPA draft: https://docusign.net/FinServ-RDW-DPA-draft. If you need the full pen-test report we can open an NDA; procurement, please advise.

Next steps (owners & ETA):
- Rafael: upload stubs and schedule call (done).
- Karthik: deep-dive slides + export mapping (ETA: 2026-11-10 EOD).
- Marissa: pilot onboarding checklist + one-pager (ETA: 2026-11-10 EOD).
- FinServ: confirm whether procurement needs full pen test + confirm legal reviewer contact (ETA: 2026-11-09 COB).

Thanks all — looking forward to the deep-dive.

--
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Anna Walsh <anna.walsh@finserv-co.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-09T09:41:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Security discovery recap & next steps — SOC 2 / pen test / DPA items

Anna / Rafael — quick note to say I pulled the onboarding checklist and a one-pager for the pilot. Highlights included in the one-pager:
- Pilot scope: 4-week pilot, Hosted or Dedicated (we recommend Dedicated for isolation + auditability).
- Data flows: what we collect for inference logs, admin logs, telemetry; where each is retained and how to export.
- Compliance attachments: SOC2 summary + pen test summary (full reports via NDA).

I'll bring the checklist and the one-pager to the deep-dive and we will demo the export UI (signed JSONL export) and the retention settings. If Jordan needs a pre-call doc, I can send a 1-page mapping of Redwood logs -> FinServ regulatory categories before the meeting.

See you Wednesday 14:00 PST.

--
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
